name: New Life
overview: Scripture reveals that new life is a transformative gift from God, rooted in His loving purpose and plan for peace and hope as stated in Jeremiah 29:11. This new life is made possible through faith in Jesus Christ, who was given so that believers may receive everlasting life (John 3:16). Romans 6:4 explains that through baptism, believers symbolically share in Christ's death and resurrection, enabling them to walk in newness of life. Furthermore, Ephesians 4:22 calls believers to actively put off their old, corrupt ways, reflecting the moral renewal that accompanies this new life in Christ.
